verdict.rationale: Zep itself generates AI-derived output from the user's data. It produces natural-language thread summaries that it updates incrementally, and with scope="auto" it composes a ready-to-use context block from edges, nodes, observations and summaries. This is summarization and retrieval delivered through the API for agents; there is no evidence of proactive insights or suggestions surfaced to the user inside the product. Missing for 10: actionable AI suggestions or recommendations, an in-product (dashboard) insights experience, insight generation beyond summaries and context assembly, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: A thread summary is a natural-language summary of the messages in a single thread, generated and incrementally updated by Zep.
let Zep dynamically compose the most relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block.
